post.caption:
Europa may hold more liquid water than all of Earth's oceans combined, under kilometres of ice, far outside where sunlight could keep anything liquid. The heat comes from tidal flexing: Jupiter squeezes it, and because the orbit is not circular the squeeze changes as it goes round, generating heat continuously with no sunlight involved. Enceladus does the same at Saturn and vents plumes into space, which a spacecraft flew through and found water, salts and organics in. You do not have to drill.
